name: io.github.idss-mesa/edi-mcp
title: EDI Data Repository
description: Search, inspect, preview, download and cite LTER/EDI ecological data packages (EDI PASTA+).

environmentVariables.name: EDI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EDI API key (https://auth.edirepository.org). Optional: without it edi-mcp reads the anonymous DataONE replicas, and lineage, change feeds, read counts and package zips are unavailable.
